title: Brain Stroke Classification Using CT Scans with Transformer-Based Models and Explainable AI.
summary: Three-class CT classification results are reported; MaxViT+cGAN achieved 98.00% accuracy and AUC 0.9975. ImageNet-pretrained MaxViT/transformer classifiers were fine-tuned on CT images; cGAN synthesis was used only for training augmentation. The paper specifies a stratified 80/20 train/test split, with synthetic images excluded from validation/test. This is internal image-set validation only; source does not establish external clinical or outcome benefit. A transformer-based CT model classified no stroke, ischemic stroke and hemorrhagic stroke in a Turkish Ministry of Health image dataset; MaxViT with cGAN augmentation reported 98% accuracy on the held-out test set.
